scores.notes: Both show towering water walls and a hill town, but the left sky is bright pale daylight/dawn with a sunlit horizon while the right is a dark stormy night sky with moonlight; the day-versus-night lighting conflicts.

Left: haloed Jesus standing in the boat; right: haloed figure on the cross. Both have the same shoulder-length dark brown hair, full dark beard, long narrow face and olive skin, in matching blue himation over light chiton.

Left Jesus on the water is clear (long dark hair, full dark beard). The right crucified figure is a tiny distant figure with a bowed head; only dark hair and beard are visible and the face cannot be judged.

Left crucified Jesus has long dark brown hair, a short full dark beard and slim build; the small right figure standing on the waves shows the same long dark hair, dark beard and slim build in a blue-grey cloak over a light tunic, with nothing conflicting.

Both are night scenes on the same sandy shore and seabed beside the sea with glowing light overhead. Left shows the path between water walls and right shows Moses on the adjoining beach with cliffs and a town; the right sea is not visibly parted yet, but nothing about the place conflicts.

Left Jesus at the tomb is clear (long dark wavy hair, full dark beard). The right crucified figure is small and distant with a bowed, thorn-crowned head; only dark hair and beard can be seen and the face can't be judged.
The distant left figure on the water and the close-up right figure at the tomb share long dark brown wavy hair to the shoulders, a full dark beard, similar apparent age (about 30s) and slim build.

The left Moses at the shore and the right Moses with the staff beside Aaron are both elderly with a bald or high balding crown, white hair at the sides, a long full white beard and weathered tan skin. The left's side hair is somewhat longer and wavier, which is not a clear conflict.

The left crucified figure is tiny and distant with a bowed head; only dark hair and beard are visible. The right Jesus at the tomb is clear (long dark wavy hair, dark beard), but identity can't be compared from the left.

Compared Peter's head in both icons (left leaping from the boat, right haloed and reaching from the boat): both have short curly dark-grey hair, a short salt-and-pepper beard, the same oval face and skin tone. The right is slightly greyer but still reads as one individual.
Left Jesus at the tomb and right Jesus on the boat both have long dark brown wavy hair, a full dark beard, a similar long face and olive skin at a similar age.

Left Peter leaping by day and right Peter stepping onto the water at night are both middle-aged men with dark greying hair and a salt-and-pepper beard greying at the chin. The left curls are tighter and the right hair looser and wavier, but no clear identity cue conflicts.

The left crucified figure is small and distant with a bowed, thorn-crowned head; only dark hair and beard are visible. The right Jesus on the boat is clear (long dark hair, dark beard), but the left face can't be judged.
Left Jesus standing in the boat and the smaller right figure on the waves both have long dark brown hair to the shoulders, a full dark beard and a slim build in a dark blue mantle over a light tunic.

Both gold-sky icons show the same crossing: a sandy dry path running between parted blue-teal sea walls, with a rocky shore at the near end and light or fire in the sky. The left adds a hill town at one side, which fits a wider viewpoint.

Compared Jesus at the tomb (left, arm raised) with the distant haloed figure on the water (right): both have long dark-brown wavy hair, a full dark beard, the same adult age and olive skin, in a blue cloak over a pale tunic.

Compared Moses with the staff on the sea floor (left) and the white-bearded haloed man beside young Aaron (right): both are elderly with white hair and a long full white beard, a lean face and a dark cloak. The right Moses's hair is somewhat longer, but there is no conflicting cue.

Compared Jesus standing on the waves (left) with Jesus standing in the boat (right): both have long dark-brown hair, a dark full beard, the same age and face shape, and a blue-grey cloak over a pale tunic.

Both are night scenes with dark teal storm-wave walls of water, a wet sandy and rocky sea floor, crowds walking, and fiery light (a sky glow on the left, a pillar of fire on the right). The left is seen from the shore with desert cliffs, the right from inside the corridor, which fits a change of viewpoint.

Compared the icon Christ at Lazarus's tomb (left) with Christ walking on the water (right): both have brown, centre-parted shoulder-length hair, a short brown beard, a cross-inscribed halo, a pinkish tunic with a red stripe and a blue-black himation.

Compared watercolor Jesus at the tomb (left) with Jesus at the bow (right): both have long dark-brown hair, a full dark beard, the same adult age and face shape, and a blue-grey cloak over a pale tunic.

Daniel on the left (gazing up at the wheels) is elderly and fair-skinned, with thin grey hair and a grey beard. Daniel in the lions' den (right) is a younger man with clearly darker brown skin, close-cropped dark hair and a short salt-and-pepper beard, so skin tone and age conflict.
Compared the small crucified icon figure (left) with Christ at the tomb (right): both have brown shoulder-length hair, a short brown beard, a cross-inscribed halo and a blue himation.

Compared Moses beside Aaron (left) with the staff-bearing leader in the centre of the column (right): both are elderly with wavy white hair, a full white beard and a lean, lined face, wearing a dark-brown cloak over a pale tunic.

Compared Moses on the shore with his arm outstretched (left) with the staff-bearing leader in the centre of the column (right): both are elderly with swept-back white hair, a full white beard and a lean face, wearing a dark-brown cloak over a pale tunic.

Compared Moses with the staff at the left edge of the sea floor (left) with the haloed Moses stretching his arm over the sea (right): both are elderly with white hair, a full white beard and a lean face, in a brown cloak over a pale tunic.

Compared Moses raising his staff on the shore (left) with Moses standing at the right of the column (right): both are elderly with white, ear-length-or-longer hair, a full white beard, a tanned lean face, and a dark-brown cloak over a pale tunic.

Compared icon Christ walking on the water (left) with the crucified figure (right): both have brown shoulder-length hair, a short brown beard and a cross-inscribed halo, with a blue himation over a pale tunic.

Compared Jesus standing in the boat (left) with Jesus on the water in the distance (right): both have long dark-brown wavy hair, a full dark beard, the same age and face shape, and a blue-grey cloak over a pale tunic.
Compared Jesus on the water (left) with Jesus at the tomb calling out (right): both have long dark-brown wavy hair, a full dark beard, the same adult age, and a blue-grey cloak over a pale tunic.
Compared Jesus standing in the boat (left) with Jesus at the tomb (right): both have long dark-brown wavy shoulder-length hair, a full dark beard, olive skin and similar age and build.
Compared Peter stepping from the boat (left) with Peter leaping toward shore (right): both have short curly dark-grey hair, a grey salt-and-pepper beard and the same weathered middle-aged face.
Compared the crucified Jesus (left, head bowed) with Jesus standing in the boat (right): both have long dark-brown hair past the shoulders, a full dark beard and a slim olive-skinned face.
Jesus in the boat (left) is clear, but in the right image the crucified figure is a tiny distant shape on the hilltop cross, and the face is unreadable beyond dark hair.

Left Moses (beside Aaron) is bald on top with a fringe of white hair and a long chest-length white beard. Right Moses on the sea floor has a full head of swept-back white hair and a shorter beard. The bald crown is the conflicting cue.
Compared Moses at the shore (left) with Moses beside Aaron (right): both are elderly men with swept-back white hair, a full white-grey beard, a gaunt tanned face and a dark brown cloak.

Compared Moses beside Aaron (left, frontal) with Moses at the sea (right, profile): both have white-grey hair, a white beard of similar length, tanned skin and an elderly build. The right one's hair looks longer and flowing, but the frontal view on the left hides the back of his head.

Left icon Moses has long white hair flowing past his shoulders and a long white beard down to the chest. Right Moses at the sea has short grey-white hair ending at the nape and a short trimmed beard just below the chin. Hair and beard length conflict.

Compared icon Jesus in the boat (left) with Jesus at Lazarus's tomb (right): both have identical center-parted brown hair falling behind the shoulder, a short brown beard and moustache, and the same long face with a cross-halo.

Compared Jesus at the tomb (left) with the crucified Jesus (right, head bowed): both have long dark-brown wavy hair, a full dark beard and an olive-skinned slim face, with the same blue cloak over a white tunic.

Compared Peter on the water at night (left) with Peter leaping from the boat at dawn (right): both have short curly greying hair, a grey-tipped beard of the same style and length, and a similar middle-aged face. The left is greyer-looking only through night lighting, which darkens his hair and skin.

Compared icon Jesus on the water (left) with icon Jesus in the boat (right): both have the same center-parted brown hair falling behind the shoulder, a short brown beard and moustache, and the same face and halo.
Compared Moses on the sea floor (left) with Moses beside Aaron (right): both have white swept-back hair, a medium white beard, a deeply tanned weathered face and a brown cloak over a pale tunic.

Jesus on the water (right) is clear, with long dark hair and a dark beard. In the left image the crucified figure is small and distant on the cross, with his head bowed, so the face is too small to judge beyond dark hair.

Compared Moses on the sea floor (left) with Moses at the sea (right, profile): both have white-grey hair, a white beard of similar length, tanned skin, an elderly build and a brown cloak. The right one's hair looks longer, but the left view hides the back of his head.
